A day care is defined as an establishment providing for the care supervision protection or support of individuals of any age required care or support.
On a regular periodic or temporary basis and includes child care centers as defined by the child care act 2014, but does not include the provision of overnight supervision.

A residential day care is summarized as an accessory use to a residential dwelling where the occupants of the dwelling provide for the care supervision protection or support of individuals of any age where the maximum number of children under care is 12.
